description: Search ~8,900 Max for Live devices for Ableton Live. Fuzzy full-text match (title/author/description, identical to max4.live) plus filters. Compose for natural language, e.g. "popular free MIDI devices from the last 2 weeks" -> type=[MIDI Effect,MIDI Generator,MIDI Transformation], license=[free], sort=downloads, added_after=<date>.

added_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only devices added on/after this date.

license.description: License buckets. free=freeware, commercial=paid, cc=any Creative Commons. For 'free to use' pass [free, cc].

query.description: Free-text fuzzy search (name, author, keyword). Omit to browse by filters only.

sort.description: Default relevance (Fuse ranking with a query, else newest).

name: search_devices
title: Search Max for Live devices
